ai_overview.text: Hyperhidrosis (excessive sweating) treatment in Guntur is available through specialized dermatologists and skin clinics . Common local options include prescription-strength antiperspirants, oral medications, and targeted clinical procedures like Botox injections. Top-rated local centers include Leelavathi Advanced Skin & Laser Center in Kothapet and Manoharam Skin, Laser and Cosmetology Clinic in Lakshmipuram.
